input.quote: 13.1 Subject to payment of applicable Fees, Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a worldwide, non-exclusive right during the subscription term to access and use the hosted Services and documentation for their internal business purposes and to provide services to Customer.
input.rationale: Section 13 meets the preferred position in full. 13.1 grants the subscription licence directly to Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf (with Authorized User sublicensing), so no notice mechanic is needed to add affiliates. 13.2 grants a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to Customer and its Affiliates for paid-up software and Vendor Technology embedded in Deliverables, with contractor support rights (confirmed by 14.3 for Vendor Technology needed to use a Deliverable). 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24 (which allows assignment to an M&A successor without consent) and limits revocation or suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure. The word "revocable" and any at-will revocation right are absent, and the 13.4 restrictions are standard and expressly preserve lawful reverse-engineering, authorized security testing, and use of Customer Data and output. No redline required.
